meta.name: Snetterton
meta.description: Snetterton, 300 (4.78 km), 200 (3.22 km) and 100 (1.58 km) circuits from OpenStreetMap, with heights, camber and terrain from the Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM (1 m). A flat former wartime airfield in open Norfolk farmland.

kerbs.source: driver61.com Snetterton 300 guide: 'I wouldn't advise using any of the kerbs' at the apexes (steep, old school); the outside exit kerb marks the edge of the usable road
driver61.com: a red sausage kerb on the inside before the apex; a triangle of exit kerb on the left
driver61.com: run the kerb from 1/4 to 3/4 of the way along; run the exit kerb but not beyond it
driver61.com: the apex kerb is usable; the exit kerb is plenty visible
driver61.com: the inside kerb with a large block; use all of the kerbing on the outside
driver61.com: use all of the apex kerb; grass-crete on the inside, worn grass at the exit
driver61.com: all of the inside kerb (careful with the tyre block); all of the exit kerbing
driver61.com: kerbing on the inside, run-off on the outside
driver61.com: all of the inside kerb (stay off the sausage kerb); all of the exit kerbing
driver61.com: the apex half way along the kerbing, all usable; a little of the exit kerbing
driver61.com: a small inside kerb that becomes a large, wide kerb after about 20 m
driver61.com: all of the inside kerb (not the sausage); all of the exit kerbing, a track-limits sensor beyond
